Carrier checks weekday rules
The purpose of this section is to describe one way of working

Companion Animal Travel Desk Daily Handling

At Aurelia Skyways, we keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk steady, calm, and clear so every traveler gets the same careful support. Start by checking the booking details, the animal's basic needs, and any notes from earlier contact before you speak with the traveler. Use plain language, stay patient, and keep your focus on safety over speed. If the situation seems crowded or uncertain, slow the work down and bring in the right support instead of guessing. The welfare coordinator looks at comfort needs, while the safety coordinator checks hazards and prevention before any travel plan moves ahead.

When you speak with the traveler, explain the required steps in order and avoid mixing comfort guidance with safety guidance. Keep the record clean and complete, and make sure any special instructions are written in the correct place. If a traveler brings up a concern about space, handling, or the animal's condition, listen first and then pass the issue to the right person without delay. If the case is simple, follow the normal desk routine and keep the handoff smooth for the next team.

Do not promise an outcome before the checks are done, and do not rush a case just because the line is busy. Keep the desk area tidy, protect privacy, and use calm wording with travelers and other staff. Samuel Petrov and Sara Moretti may ask for help with the same process as any other traveler, and the same steady approach applies. If Simba or any other animal appears stressed, make the welfare concern clear in the notes and alert the proper support team right away. If you are unsure at any point, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor at Aurelia Skyways for immediate guidance.
